title: General Liability Appetite and Eligibility Guide (Synthetic)

passages.text: Janitorial, facilities maintenance, and light commercial services are generally eligible for General Liability when revenue is between $500,000 and $50,000,000 and operations exclude demolition, crane work, and roofing above three stories.
Any single claim with incurred severity at or above $250,000 requires senior underwriter referral before quoting. Three or more claims in five years require enhanced loss analysis.
Delegated underwriting authority for occurrence limits is $2,000,000. Requests above this limit require senior referral and documented rationale.

A complete GL submission requires ACORD application, currently valued loss runs (minimum 3 years), revenue confirmation, and operations description. Missing loss runs must be requested before bind recommendation.

Prohibited operations include demolition, underground mining, fireworks manufacturing, and cannabis-related exposures. These classes are out of appetite and should receive a decline recommendation after human approval.
